purpose: Make file reads, writes, edits, moves, copies, deletes, and artifact publication verifiable and recoverable instead of relying on chat assumptions or ambiguous filenames.

preferred_identity: repository path plus git blob/commit sha
owner artifact id plus task id
weak_identity: search result title without stable id
cached local path after session boundary
identity_rules.rule: Do not mutate or delete an artifact using weak identity when a stable identity can be resolved.

before_material_use: resolve the current authoritative or intended source
read the exact current version needed for the task
record source/version provenance when the content affects a durable decision
read_rules.cached_or_previous_read: A prior chat read, cached summary, or remembered content does not satisfy a current authority read when freshness is material.
read_rules.partial_read: A partial excerpt may support a narrow fact but must not be treated as proof of unseen file content.

before_write: confirm whether create, replace, patch, append, move, or copy is intended
check current version or expected revision for conflict-sensitive stores
after_write: reread the written content or verify provider metadata/version
confirm the stable reference now points to the intended artifact
record downstream invalidation if content changed materially
write_update_rules.commit_semantics: Do not claim a material file mutation is committed until the postcondition is verified.

before_delete: check whether active task, audit, publication, migration, or accepted-output evidence depends on it
confirm a replacement authority exists when deleting a superseded implementation or duplicate
forbidden_without_owner_retention_author: artifact referenced by an active next_action
delete_rules.safe_default: If dependency or retention status is unknown, do not delete; mark for owner review or remove only from the active execution path when reversible.

copy_move_rules.rule: After a move or canonicalization, update stable references and ensure stale copies cannot remain on the active path.

chatgpt_library.note: The user may clear Library independently; Universal and durable owners must remain recoverable without it.

notion.allowed_use: Explicit user-requested reference/evidence only when provenance is preserved.

allowed_for: owner-designated business evidence when the owner contract records the stable Drive reference
not_allowed_as: automatic replacement for GitHub main or owner task manifest
required_when_used_as_artifact_vault: stable provider id or canonical Drive reference
version or updated metadata when available

generated_deliverable_policy.durable_destination: owner-declared artifact store; Google Drive is an allowed optional artifact vault when configured

stale_and_superseded_handling.superseded_engineering_file: remove from active tree after replacement and migration dependency checks; Git history remains archive
stale_and_superseded_handling.duplicate_external_copy: remove/archive from active reference surface when safe; never let it outrank the canonical source
stale_and_superseded_handling.superseded_generated_deliverable: retain only if owner retention/audit requires it; otherwise archive or remove from the active delivery index
